A ramp from 100 to 124 across 160 pixels, with a wave of 6 levels down the rows, rounded to steps of 4 levels, so each band is about 27 pixels wide. The numbers are the PSNR in dB between the 5 x 5 local mean of the result and the smooth ramp, away from the border. This measures how well the steps blend, while ignoring the fine grain the filter adds. The banded ramp itself has 49.26 dB. A threshold of 3 is below the step of 4, so nothing changes. A range of 32 is longer than a band, so more references reach a band that differs by more than the threshold, and fewer pixels are replaced.
